title: Page parameters
must: Paper size (A4), orientation, margins (top, bottom, left/binding, right, gutter), header/footer distance; set in Page Setup, belong to a section; set them first.

title: Landscape section
must: A wide ERD / table goes in its own section set to landscape; the rest stays portrait.

title: Page numbering
must: PAGE field, not typed; Format Page Numbers: format (1,2,3 / i,ii,iii), Start at, chapter number; title page unnumbered, front matter i, ii, iii, main text restarts at 1 (needs sections).

title: Indents and line spacing
must: First-line, hanging, left/right indents; line spacing single / 1.5 / double; spacing before/after instead of Enter twice; put them in styles (Normal).

title: By hand vs proper tools
must: At least three pairs: Tab/spaces → first-line indent, Enter twice → spacing after, typed numbers → PAGE field, shrinking a diagram → landscape section, line breaks → hanging indent.

title: Section breaks
must: Divide the document into sections, each with its own header/footer, number format, margins, orientation; Next page vs Continuous; a page break cannot do this.

title: Fields and styles
must: Field = automatic code updated by the word processor: PAGE, NUMPAGES, DATE, FILENAME, STYLEREF; style = named formatting set — changing it changes all text using it.

title: Header and footer options
must: Different first page, different odd & even pages, Link to previous (switch off for a new header), page-number format, header/footer distance — with when to use each.

title: Giving a chapter its own header
must: Section break (Next page) → open header → switch off Link to Previous → type title or STYLEREF → Format Page Numbers / Start at 1 → check the previous section.

title: Footnote and endnote formatting
must: Location, number format (different for footnotes and endnotes), custom mark, Start at, numbering (continuous / restart each section), Convert; note separator.

title: Footnote Text style
must: Change the look of all notes by modifying the Footnote Text style, not note by note; never type note numbers by hand.

title: Header row and caption
must: Header row repeated on every page (Repeat Header Rows); numbered caption via Insert Caption — above a table, below a figure.

title: Cross-reference
must: A field that refers to a caption, heading or page ('see Table 3 on page 12') and updates when it moves or is renumbered.

title: Table formatting tools
must: At least three: table styles, banded rows, borders/shading, alignment, column width / AutoFit, merge/split cells, rows not breaking across pages.

title: Common mistakes
must: Link to previous left on, page break instead of section break, typed page/footnote numbers, Enter twice for gaps, same format for footnotes and endnotes.
